summary: Kandal M Venture Limited filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that Nasdaq confirmed on October 30, 2026 that the company regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement. The deficiency originated in a December 22, 2025 notice covering the November 6–December 19, 2025 closing bids, with an initial 180-day cure period later extended to December 21, 2026. Compliance followed ten consecutive business days (October 16–29, 2026) at or above $1.00; the matter is closed. No deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation were disclosed; watch for renewed sub-$1 pressure.
